items.period: Shang oracle-bone script style; linked specimen 甲2402 合1977 (no artifact date assigned here)
items.caption: Modern vector rendering of a Shang oracle-bone 生, cited to the specimen recorded as 甲2402 合1977. The paleographic analysis reads the graph as a sprout over ground.
items.alt: A black vector form identified by its description page as 生 in Shang oracle-bone style.
items.selection_reason: Provides an early graphic example directly relevant to the supported sprout-over-ground analysis; the Commons description supplies a specimen identifier and reuse provenance.
items.rights: Commons description labels the representation public domain and identifies the Sinica source image as CC0 1.0.

items.period: Western Zhou bronze style; description links 七年趞曹鼎 and calls it mid Western Zhou
items.caption: Modern vector rendering of a Western Zhou bronze-script 生, linked by the file description to 七年趞曹鼎 (mid Western Zhou). It offers a second stage for comparison with the oracle-bone form.
items.alt: A black vector form identified by its description page as 生 in Western Zhou bronze-script style.
items.selection_reason: Adds the intermediate bronze stage discussed in the paleographic account and provides a source-reported inscription context.
items.rights: Commons description states that the Sinica source picture is CC0 1.0; Commons labels the vector representation public domain.

items.period: Shuowen seal-script style; modern digital rendering, not an artifact photograph
items.caption: Modern vector reconstruction of 生 in Shuowen seal-script style. It illustrates a later script form, not a photographed ancient inscription.
items.alt: A black vector form identified by its description page as 生 in Shuowen seal-script style.
items.selection_reason: Shows the later seal-script form mentioned in the paleographic account while making its status as a reconstruction explicit.
items.rights: Commons identifies the vector representation as public domain and records Richard Sears permission/copyright provenance.

limitations.text: The glyphs are proposed from inspected description-page identity and provenance. Their pixels were not visually inspected in this research stage; downstream visual review is needed.

Xiaoxuetang’s public query page returned only a sparse shell in this browser, so these selected candidates use the Commons pages and their stated source/rights information; no direct Xiaoxuetang query image was selected.
